episode_title: Building the Next Generation of Supply Chain Leaders: Inside DHL's Intern Program

real_qa.q: How many interns does DHL Supply Chain typically recruit each summer and how many college direct hires does the company average annually?
real_qa.r: DHL Supply Chain typically has between 280 and 300 interns in the summer, with 286 interns in the past year. The company averages about 250 direct college hires annually. These numbers demonstrate the scale of DHL's early talent recruiting strategy across North America.
real_qa.requete: DHL internship program size numbers interns hires

real_qa.q: What is the DHL Supply Chain capstone project and how many business partners participate in the capstone event?
real_qa.r: The capstone event is the culmination of the summer internship experience where all 286 interns from across North America are brought into Columbus, Ohio, to present their projects and showcase their work. The event draws 240 business partners who interact, network, attend professional development workshops, and evaluate whether interns will receive offers for post-graduation roles.
real_qa.requete: DHL capstone event interns Columbus Ohio business partners

real_qa.q: How many capstone projects did DHL's college recruiting team develop across U.S. and Canada operations this year?
real_qa.r: DHL's college recruiting team identified 55 different capstone projects this year across the U.S. and Canada. These projects are developed in collaboration with business champions in each region who identify opportunities from day-to-day operations that interns can tackle, focusing on improvement in transportation, new technology, standardization, and associated experience.
real_qa.requete: DHL capstone projects 55 number business improvement

real_qa.q: What specific WMS system did TCL Supply Chain interns consolidate into a real-time dashboard as part of their capstone project?
real_qa.r: Interns working on the TCL Supply Chain site-specific capstone project consolidated the Blue Yonder WMS system into a real-time visible dashboard for supervisors on the floor to help them make quicker operational decisions. The project team consisted of four interns: one at TCL Supply Chain, two at EV Logistics, and one at Matrix.
real_qa.requete: Blue Yonder WMS TCL Supply Chain dashboard capstone

real_qa.q: What employee resource groups did DHL interns work to bring to the hourly associate population through their capstone project?
real_qa.r: Interns developed tool packs to bring DHL's employee resource groups, formerly called employee alliances, to the hourly associate population. These included specific groups like Pride and the Hispanic Heritage Alliance, tailored to be implemented at individual sites depending on their unique characteristics and needs.
real_qa.requete: DHL employee resource groups alliances Pride Hispanic Heritage

real_qa.q: How many warehouse startup sites does DHL operate annually, requiring labor and resource planning according to interns' capstone project?
real_qa.r: DHL has approximately 50 warehouse startup sites each year. Interns created an Excel tool to standardize the labor and resource planning process for these startup sites, helping Solutions Design and operations teams plan the gradual ramp-up of labor and resources needed week by week as new warehouses begin operations.
real_qa.requete: DHL startup warehouse sites 50 labor resource planning

guest.titre: Senior Director of Talent Acquisition for North America and Canada
guest.bio_context: Chris Kitchen has been with DHL Supply Chain for 14 and a half years. He leads a college recruiting team comprised of about 10 individuals that support early talent recruiting across the U.S. and Canada for apprentice roles, junior level associate interns, and post-graduation direct hires. He oversees DHL's internship program and capstone project, which brings hundreds of college students into the organization each summer for real-world supply chain experience.

real_quote: Supply chain continues to evolve and it's becoming more technology enabled, more data driven than we even are today. It's complex. It continues to get more complex.
